label: The route's intended reading of 'necessary being' is one of the enumerated senses
paraphrase: OPEN coverage premise, attribution deferred: the route's intended reading of 'necessary being' is one of the enumerated senses (box-existence in K, actualist K, de dicto K, T, S4, KTB, S5; tertia via 'cannot not-be'; necessary per se). Exhaustiveness of the finite enum is free; that it lists every defensible reading is not provable in Lean and is attacked by proposing a further sense (logical necessity and Scott/Goedel essence-based necessary existence are recorded as left out).
